proved: Over an algebraically closed field, independent geometric superspeciality implies zero actual Verschiebung cotangent map, in every dimension.

For every presented separable quintic/sextic in odd characteristic over an algebraically closed field, geometric superspeciality implies Cartier zero on the entire regular/global differential space and coefficient matrix zero, for any representing Jacobian and base point.
The original geometric elliptic p-torsion definition implies actual Verschiebung cotangent vanishing; the proof uses the actual finite kernel, its cotangent space and degree p.
Actual multiplication-by-n for n nonzero is finite, flat, surjective with degree n^(2g); actual relative Frobenius and Verschiebung have degree p^g.
Over an already algebraically closed field, the geometric product-isomorphism/isogeny predicates are equivalent to the corresponding predicates over that ground field.
The actual fifth-power curves with p congruent to 2 or 3 modulo 5 are not geometrically superspecial.

Over a perfect field, the universal differential kernel in any normal domain consists exactly of pth powers; genuine unique Frobenius factorizations are constructed for affine maps and for global scheme maps with the stated section-root or stalk-differential hypotheses.
